name: Guahalan Alebrujo
description: A huge, colorful, chimeric beast formed from many animals.

abilities.name: The Beast Unleashed
abilities.description: The Alebrujo gains a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

abilities.name: Guahalan Sacrifice
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to have the Alebrujo devour a Minion within Very Close range, then clear a HP or a Stress.

abilities.name: Howl of the Guahala
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to have the Alebrujo emit a howl. Each PC within Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or become temporarily Panicked. While Panicked, a PC must mark a Stress when they take the spotlight.

abilities.name: Rip & Tear
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, you can mark a Stress to make another standard attack against an additional target within range. You can continue marking Stress to make additional attacks until the Alebrujo fails an attack roll.

abilities.name: Brutal Spectacle
abilities.description: When the Alebrujo deals Severe damage, you can spend a Fear to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress.
